Commentary.Commentary: That's all we have from this match! Third ODI will be a dead rubber but both teams will be going hard for a win for different reasons. Sri Lanka would love to inflict a clean sweep whereas West Indies would like to avoid the same. Do join us on 1st March at 1430 local (0900 GMT) for all the action. Until then, it's goodbye and cheers!

Dimuth Karunaratne, the Sri Lankan skipper, thanks his teammates first of all. Credits Mendis and Fernando for their fantastic batting performance. Mentions how Wanindu and Sandakan were outstanding, and that the fast bowlers were good as well. On being asked about Major Perera's performance, Dimuth says that he did well with the ball and the bat as well. When asked about Mickey Arthur, their coach, Karunaratne says that is a nice guy and that he supports them at every turn. Adds that he gives them self-confidence on and off the pitch. Ends by thanking the crowd for coming out in such large numbers.

Kieron Pollard, the West Indian skipper, says that the partnership between Fernando and Mendis took the game away from them after the 2 early wickets. Adds that the ground was big and both the wrist spinners were looking for wickets taking advantage of that. On being asked whether he would like to change something from today's performance, he laughs and says everything. Adds that he is disappointed about how the team failed in crunch moments. Ends by saying that he is disappointed with his own performances today too.

Avishka Fernando is the Player of the Match. Fernando says that he is very happy with his performance and thinks that he batted really well. Adds that there was pressure at the start after the loss of 2 early wickets. Shares that they planned to construct a partnership and praises Mendis for batting so well. Ends by saying that he likes to play against the West Indies fast bowlers as he prefers pace.

Angelo Mathews is down for a quick chat. Says that he is very happy with the victory and adds that it was a convincing one for them. Credits Avishka Fernando and Kusal Mendis for the way they batted and the partnership they had and also mentions how the bowlers performed really well. On his wonderful catch, Angelo replies that he wants to contribute in every manner possible and that he has been working a lot on his fitness. On playing his 100th ODI in Sri Lanka, Mathews says he is proud and it is a very big achievement for any person to play so many matches for the country. Stay tuned for the presentation...

In pursuit, West Indies started steadily but failed to capitalize. They were completely at sea against the Lankan wrist spinners and flopped miserably. Shai Hope once again was the only batsman to present a fight but apart from him, it was a collective failure for the touring team. A thoroughly professional effort in the field by the Lankan Lions and they deserve to be 2-0 ahead in the series.

A ruthless show one can say! Although it started on a sorry note for Sri Lanka as they lost two quick wickets upfront but that was followed by a record and marathon 239-run stand between Avishka Fernando and Kusal Mendis. Both struck fabulous centuries and propelled the home team to a gigantic total. The West Indian bowling was very flat, however, Alzarri Joseph and Sheldon Cottrell bowled some good overs at the death. Their fielding though was very mediocre with plenty of catches getting dropped and granting Mendis a life when he was on 2 haunted them the most.

Thumping win for Sri Lanka! They have registered their biggest win against West Indies in ODIs to take an unsurpassable lead in the 3-match ODI series. The Lankan dressing room is all smiles and their players are celebrating in the middle.

OUT! End of the story! Sandakan serves a flighted full ball around leg, Allen aims to go downtown and clear long on but fails to get enough distance behind his shot. Thisara Perera takes a simple catch and SRI LANKA WIN BY 161 RUNS!
Sheldon Cottrell is the last man in for the West Indies.

OUT! Pradeep strikes with a corker of a yorker. Nails it at the base of off stump, little bit of tail in the air and Joseph is late in bringing his bat down. The off stump goes for a walk and Sri Lanka are just one wicket away from taking an unassailable lead in the series.
Digs in a short ball on off, Joseph tries his best to pull but misses.
Spears in a full ball on off, Joseph tries to drive but it takes the inner half, strikes him on the front pad and rolls back to the bowler.
Resumption time! After a delay of little over 10 minutes, the floodlight is restored to its working state. Pradeep steams in...

Alzarri Joseph is the new batsman. It seems there is a light failure. One of the floodlights has stopped illuminating and we have a delay. The spectators are flashing the back light of their mobile phones. Unfortunately, that cannot help.

OUT! Pradeep destroys the stumps with his back of the hand variation. He lands it on a length around off, Paul is way too early into his shot and as a result, he fails to make any connection. Wicket number 8 goes down and the end is nigh for West Indies.
FOUR! Aerial but wide of short mid-wicket! Short in length and around off, Keemo rides the bounce and hammers his pull to the deep mid-wicket fence.
Good length ball around off, Paul stays back to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.

SIX! STOP THE PRESS! Fabian Allen has hit the first maximum of the match. A flighted full ball landing around off, Fabian finds it in his zone and launches it all the way over wide long off for a biggie.
Too full in length on off, Allen is on the front foot as he drives it to covers.
Flighted delivery on middle, Paul works it in front of square leg for a single.

NOT OUT! Missing leg. Loopy full ball landing on middle and it spins in after pitching, Paul tries to flick but misses and is rapped on the pads. They appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Karunaratne takes the referral after the request from his bowler. The replays roll in and Snicko detects no involvement of bat. Ball Tracker takes time to generate... We all wait and once it comes on the screen, the ball is seen to be spinning down and missing the leg stump.
Review time! Keemo Paul is the man in question as Sri Lanka have challenged the decision of the umpire. After a long halt, the Ball Tracker comes in and shows that the ball is going down leg.
Very full in length and around off, Fabian drives but finds the mid off fielder.

FOUR! Finds the gap! Tossed up ball around off, too full in length, Allen drives and finds the gap at extra cover for a glorious boundary. Sandakan has also overstepped and we will have a Free Hit now...
Free Hit coming up!
Shortish and on off, Fabian moves back and punches it to covers where the fielder makes a good diving stop.
Pradeep takes the pace off this one and delivers it short and wide outside off, Allen plays a mistimed punch to sweeper cover for a run.
Good variation in pace from Pradeep. Returns to bowling a speedy short ball around off, Allen swings his bat and misses. Second for the over, signals the square leg umpire.
Slower one this time, on a length around middle, Allen is early into the shot and chips it back. Doesn't carry to the bowler.
Pradeep surprises the batsman with a pacy bouncer around off, Allen tries to hook but it goes over his bat.
Pitches it up and around off, Fabian strokes it off his front foot to covers.
FOUR! Not entirely from the middle of the bat! Back of a length ball on off, Allen turns on the back foot and drags his pull wide of mid on for a boundary.
Nuwan Pradeep is back on. 4-0-24-0, his figures so far.
Flatter and shorter outside off, Paul is on the back foot in defense. End of a successful over for Sandakan.
Googly outside off, shorter in length, Paul reaches out for it and slaps it past mid off for a couple of runs.
Loopy and full on middle, Allen sweeps it to fine leg for one.
Tossed up ball on off, defended from the back foot.
Flatter ball on middle, Keemo helps it behind square leg for a single.
Fabian Allen walks in to bat now. Also, Wanindu Hasaranga has gone off the pitch now due to some fitness concerns and Shehan Jayasuriya comes out for him.

OUT! Mathews takes a blinder! He rolls back the years and shows that the fire is still burning. Big smile on the face of the veteran. Sandakan serves a flighted full ball outside off, spinning away after landing, Pooran kneels down for the slog sweep but fails to middle his shot. It finds the top edge and balloons in the air towards mid-wicket. Mathews in the vicinity quickly moves across to his right and completes the catch with a full length dive. Final nail in the West Indian coffin, only formalities left in this run chase now.
Wide! Floated full ball down the leg side, Pooran tries his best to sweep but misses.
Hasaranga goes slower in the air and drops it short outside off, Paul hangs back and once again pushes it back to the bowler. Wanindu bowls out for the evening with outstanding figures of 10-0-30-3.
Fullish and on off, Keemo strokes it back off the front foot.
A touch short in length and outside off, Keemo jumps back inside the crease and punches it to short cover.
Quicker and flatter on off, fuller in length, Paul leans forward in defense.
Flatter and shorter around off, Pooran reverse pulls it through backward point for a single.
Too full in length around leg, Pooran drives it back on one bounce to the bowler.

Drinks break. The Lankan Lions are roaring in this match! Their spinners are ruling the roost and have accounted for 4 wickets so far. It's been a completely lackluster batting show by West Indies. Their middle order refused to put up a fight and now they are staring down at a series loss. Let's see for how long they can avoid the inevitable. 190 needed off 96 balls with only one recognized batsman left.
On the pads, this one is worked towards the mid-wicket region.
This time Keemo pierces the gap at cover-point and takes a couple.
A flatter one and short in length, Paul looks to make room and hit this one but the ball stays low and beats him.
Floated on middle and off, Paul hits it straight back towards the bowler off the inner half of his bat.
FOUR! Slapped! Very short in length, Paul rocks back and slams this one towards wide long on for a boundary.
Flatter and shorter on off, Paul pushes this one through extra cover for a couple.
Floated on middle and off, Paul has driven this one towards mid off for a single.
FOUR! Flatter and shorter delivery on middle and leg, Paul rocks back and pulls this one behind square leg for a boundary.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Appeal turned down! Again the wrong 'un by Hasaranga, Paul looks to flick but misses and is hit on the pads. A loud appeal follows but it is turned down. Might be an inside edge on that.
Pooran again brings out the reverse sweep and gets a single towards point.
Another floated ball on middle and off, Pooran looks to defend but misses.
Way wide outside off, it is a wrong 'un. Paul makes room and stretches to get to it but misses.
This time Keemo plays the sweep shot but it goes straight to the man at square leg.
On the pads of Paul, he works this one towards mid-wicket.
Paul goes onto the back foot and defends this one out.
This time a very low full toss down the leg side, Pooran again goes for the reverse sweep but this time just a run results towards point.
FOUR! Reverse swept! Wide outside off, tossed up, Pooran gets down on one knee and reverse sweeps it past the fielder at short third man for a boundary.
Floated ball on off, Paul stretches forward and defends it back.
Keemo Paul is the new man in.

OUT! Wrong 'un accompanied by the lack of bounce is a recipe for disaster and disaster it is for Jason Holder. Third wicket for Hasaranga and he is over the moon. Hurls across a flighted delivery outside off, Holder stays back and looks to defend but it stays low and turns back in to beat his bat. The stumps once again get disturbed and West Indies are staring down the barrel.
Slightly short and on off, Pooran gets back and steers it through cover-point for a run.
Hangs on the back foot to a short ball and punches it to short cover.
Pitches it up and outside off, Holder pushes it through covers for a run.
Flighted delivery on middle, it's played on the leg side towards mid-wicket.
On off, defended watchfully.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot.
Floated delivery around the off pole line, Pooran looks to have a poke at it but the ball takes an outside edge and goes towards the slip cordon for a couple.
Floated delivery on off, Pooran looks to go for the reverse sweep but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Tossed up on off, Pooran defends it towards the off side.
Floated delivery on off, Holder prods forward and works it down to long on for a single.
Very full and on middle, Holder eases it down to long on for a run.
Tossed up ball around off, Holder stretches forward with his long reach and defends it down.
Defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

Stifled appeal for an lbw! Another googly, landing around off and spinning back in with extra bounce. Holder plays for the leg break and gets beaten. It pings him on the front pad, they appeal but it's clearly going down leg.
Jason Holder walks out to bat now.

OUT! Golden duck for Kieron Pollard! Body blow to West Indies and their glimmer of hope. Great delivery by Hasaranga. Once again he has deceived the batsman with a well-disguised wrong 'un. He dishes it out on a fuller length outside off, Pollard tries to drive it through the line but it spins back in to beat his bat and destroys the stumps behind. West Indies are now reduced to half!
A slip comes in for Kieron Pollard.
Flighted ball on middle, Pooran gets back and flicks it in the gap at mid-wicket for a run.
Kieron Pollard arrives in the middle. 216 needed off 132 balls.

OUT! BOWLED! Sandakan gets the breakthrough and Chase's dogged innings comes to an end. A floated delivery on the off pole line, Chase prods forward to flick it across the line but it turns past the inside edge of his bat. The ball shatters into the stumps behind and a wicket for Sandakan after 184 deliveries in ODIs. This will do his confidence a world of good and Sri Lanka continue to be on top here!
Floated on middle and leg, worked towards mid-wicket.
Good batting! Pooran follows up two boundaries with a single towards cover.
FOUR! Again Pooran comes down the track and lofts it over the fielder at mid-wicket for another boundary. Pooran looking to break the shackles.
Floated on middle and off, Pooran defends it off the front foot.

FOUR! Time for aggression by West Indies and taking the lead is Pooran! He comes charging down the track, gets underneath the ball and lofts it over the fielder at mid-wicket inside the circle for a boundary. First boundary after 7 overs for the Windies.
Floated delivery around middle and leg, Pooran works this one towards  mid-wicket for one.
On the pads of Chase, he works it with power towards the leg side but just a single taken
Pooran drives this through the covers. One run added to the total.

Appeal turned down! Pitching outside leg most probably! Floated delivery around leg, Pooran looks to go for the sweep shot but misses to get hit on the pad. Sri Lanka ask the question but the umpire says not out.
Flatter one on off, defended.
Down the leg side, Chase works it towards mid-wicket and gets a single.
Floated on middle and off, Pooran hammers it straight back and almost takes his partner at the other end. Chase leans back to make way but Mathews cuts it off at mid on.
Flatter and fuller on off, punched down to long on for one.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Floated on off, Pooran drives it through the cover region. The fielder does well to stop it just inside the ropes and the batters are able to take three runs.
Flatter and short delivery around middle and off, Pooran slaps it into the ground and back towards the bowler.
Chase plays this one down to long on and gets to the other end.
Flatter one again, Chase punches it down to long on for one. Chase will keep strike for the next over.
Flatter one on off, pushed towards the man at mid off.
On the pads, worked towards the leg side for a single.
BEATEN! Tossed up delivery around the leg pole line, Pooran goes for the reverse sweep but misses. The ball misses the leg pole by a whisker as it goes over it.
Loopy delivery on off, Pooran pushes this one towards covers.
Chase plays this flatter delivery by Hasaranga straight down the ground but for just a single.
Tossed up on off, Pooran prods forward and defends.
Chase again plays the ball down to long on for a single.
Floated on off, pushed towards cover and the batters get a run this time.
Flatter one on off, Pooran rocks back and defends.
Floated on middle and off, pushed towards long on for one.
Three Wides! Down the leg side, Chase looks to sweep it fine down the leg side but misses. Kusal Perera too misses it and the batters run two as well.
Floated on off by Hasaranga, Pooran pushes this one towards the man at covers for a single.
Down the leg side, Pooran looks to sweep this one but the ball goes off the thigh pad down the leg side and the batters steal a leg bye.
Loopy ball on off, pushed towards the gap at covers for one.
In the air but safe! Tossed up around middle and leg, Chase flicks this one uppishly towards mid-wicket but in no man's land. Two runs taken.
Floated on off again, driven towards the man at cover.
Tossed up around off, defended back towards the bowler.
Flatter one on off, pushed towards long off for a single.
Loopy delivery on middle, Chase pushes it back towards the bowler.
Flighted delivery on off, Pooran punches it towards covers for a run.
On off, Pooran drives it towards mid off.
Floated delivery on middle, Pooran sweeps it towards the leg side.
BEATEN! Flighted delivery just outside off, Pooran looks to defend but misses it.
Tossed up delivery on off, Chase drives it towards covers for a single.
Spin from both the ends now as Lakshan Sandakan comes to bowl. 1 slip in place for him as well.
Floated delivery on off, Chase drives it through covers for a single.
Full delivery on middle, Chase drives it towards mid on.
Loopy delivery on off, Chase drives it back towards the bowler.
Flighted delivery on middle, Pooran flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single and gets off the mark.
Tossed up delivery on off, Pooran plays it towards point.

OUT! Bravo is foxed by a googly! Hasaranga slows it up in the air and lands it full around middle. It lands and grips before spinning away from the left-hander as Bravo tries to flick it against the spin. The ball probably takes the back of his bat and Dhananjaya de Silva reacts well to his right at first slip to grab the catch. Wanindu is ecstatic and a disappointed Darren is on his bike. 253 needed more by West Indies off 179 balls to level the series!
Nicholas Pooran is the new man in as West Indies are in a spot of bother.
FOUR! Excellent shot! Full delivery on off, Chase drives it through covers for a boundary.
On a length on middle, Chase looks to flick but gets a leading edge. It lands safely towards covers.
Length delivery on off, Chase punches it towards point.
Good length delivery on off, Chase defends it off the front foot.
On a length on middle, Bravo flicks it towards fine leg for a single.
Full delivery on middle, Chase lofts it over mid-wicket but mistimes it. It lands safely. The batsmen take a run.
Tossed up delivery on middle, Chase flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Flighted delivery on middle, Bravo flicks it through square leg for a run.
On middle, Bravo flicks it to mid-wicket.
BEATEN! Loopy delivery outside off, Bravo looks to defend but misses it due to the turn on this one.
Floated delivery on off, Darren punches it towards point.
Tossed up delivery on middle, Bravo drives it towards mid on.
Length delivery on off, Bravo punches it towards covers for a single.
On a length on middle, Bravo flicks it to mid-wicket.
Length delivery on off, Chase guides it towards third man for a single.
Good length delivery on off, Chase plays it to covers.
On a length on middle, Chase pushes it towards mid on.
Roston Chase joins Darren Bravo, replacing Shai Hope.

OUT! CAUGHT! Mathews has hunted down the dangerous Hope in his 100th ODI at home and he is delighted. Full ball wide outside off, Hope looks to drag it towards mid-wicket but is undone by the lack of pace on the ball. The man at short mid-wicket, Dimuth Karunaratne, catches the ball over his head and it's a massive breakthrough for Sri Lanka. 263 needed off 197 balls.
Floated delivery on off, Hope lofts it over mid off for a single.
Stumping appeal taken upstairs! It is a beauty by Hasaranga to deceive Hope but replays show that Hope's foot never left the crease.

NOT OUT! Shai Hope is safe! Flighted delivery just outside off, Hope looks to defend but misses. It goes towards the keeper where Kusal Perera takes the bails off and appeals. It is referred upstairs. Replays show that Hope's foot was well inside the crease.
Floated delivery on middle, Bravo flicks it towards square leg for a run.

50 for Shai Hope, his 16th in ODIs. It has been a terrific innings from him till now. Short delivery on middle, Hope pulls it towards mid-wicket where the fielder misfields and the ball goes towards mid on. The batsmen take a run. Hope continues with his purple patch and once again holds the key for the touring team.
Flighted delivery on middle, Bravo flicks it through square leg for a single.
Tossed up delivery on middle, Bravo plays it to mid on.

Drinks! It's been a decent start for the West Indies. They would've loved to have Ambris still playing but it is not the case now. Hope though is still looking very good out in the middle and he will look to continue rotating the strike with support from the other end. Sri Lanka have the opening though with Bravo still fresh at the crease and now will try to get a couple of quick wickets to choke West Indies in this run chase. Wanindu Hasaranga comes on for the first time in this match. Can he produce some magic?
Last ball of the over and Bravo flicks this one square of the wicket on the leg side for a single.
Good length ball on middle and off, pushed towards the man at mid on.
On the pads, Hope works it towards mid-wicket and changes ends.
Hope now comes down the track looking to pierce the gap at cover but Mendis there dives low to his right and grabs the ball. Frustrating for Hope and he might commit some mistake here under pressure.
Another full ball just around the off pole, Hope digs it out.
Full ball on off, pushed towards cover.
Length delivery on middle, Bravo flicks it through mid-wicket. The batsmen get two runs.
Udana bowls a bouncer, Bravo ducks under it.
On a length on middle, Hope flicks it towards square leg for a single.
Full delivery on off, Bravo drives it through mid off. The fielder chases it and does well to stop it just before the ropes. The batsmen get three runs.
Length delivery on off, Bravo punches it to point.
Udana bowls a bouncer, Bravo does well to duck under it.
Good length delivery on middle, Shai defends it off the back foot.
On a length on middle, Hope flicks it to mid-wicket.
Length delivery on off, Bravo punches it towards point for a run.
FOUR! Pulled away! Short of a length delivery on middle and off, Bravo pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary. Bravo gets off the mark in style.
Full again on middle, Hope drives it through mid on for a single.
Full delivery on off, Hope drives it back towards the bowler.
On a good length on off, Bravo blocks it off the back foot.
BEATEN! On a good length and outside off, Bravo looks to have a poke at it on his first ball but misses. Bravo has to be more careful here.
Length delivery outside off, Hope punches it through covers for a single.
On a good length on middle, Hope defends it off the back foot.
Darren Bravo is in at no. 3.

OUT! RUN OUT! Disaster strikes and Shai Hope has sold Sunil Ambris down the river! It was becoming very difficult for the Sri Lankan bowlers to break this stand but West Indies have shot themselves in the foot here. Full ball on the pads, Hope flicks this one towards Mathews at mid-wicket. Hope sets off for a run and comes almost halfway down the pitch. His partner, Sunil Ambris, obliges but Hope then turns back. Ambris too has to turn back and tries to reach his crease at the non-striker's end. Mathews throws the ball to Udana at the non-striker's end who dislodges the bails and Ambris is well short. No need of a referral here and Ambris has to walk back. Is this the opening that the Lankans wanted?
Short delivery on middle, Ambris pulls it uppishly through mid-wicket for a single.
WIDE! Full delivery down the leg side, Ambris looks to flick but misses it.
Full delivery on middle, Ambris drives it through mid on for a single.
Length delivery on middle, Hope flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
On a length on middle, Hope plays it to covers.
Full delivery on middle, Ambris lofts it over mid on for a run.
Length delivery on middle, Ambris flicks it to mid-wicket.
On a length on middle, Hope pushes it through mid on for a single.
Angelo Mathews is brought into the attack now. Can he provide the breakthrough?
Short delivery on middle, Ambris pulls it to mid-wicket.
Length delivery on off, Hope punches it through point for a run.
On a length on off, Ambris looks to flick but gets a leading edge. It lands safely towards mid off. The batsmen cross ends.
Length delivery on off, Hope guides it towards third man for a run.
On a length on middle, Hope tucks it to mid-wicket.
Short delivery on leg, Ambris pulls it through square leg for a single.
Powerplay 2 is underway! A maximum of 4 fielders are now allowed outside the circle until the 40th over.
Good length delivery on off, Hope blocks it off the back foot. 54/0 in Powerplay 1 for West Indies, they are off to a better start than Sri Lanka!
BEATEN! Full delivery outside off, Hope looks to drive but misses it as the ball swings away a touch.
Good length delivery on off, Hope looks to defend but gets a bottom edge on this one.
Full delivery outside off, Ambris drives it through point for a single.
Length delivery on middle, Hope pushes it towards mid on for a single.
On a length on off, Hope defends it to covers.
Full delivery on middle, Ambris drives it towards mid on. 8 from Udana's first over.
BEATEN! On a good length and outside off, Ambris looks to defend but misses it.
Length delivery on off, Hope punches it through covers. The fielder chases it and does well to pull it back just before the ropes. The batsmen get three runs. 50 up for West Indies.
FOUR! Superb shot! Full delivery on middle, Hope flicks it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
On a length on middle, Hope looks to flick but gets a leading edge. It lands safely towards point.
Full delivery on middle, Ambris flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Isuru Udana is into the attack.
Full ball on off, Hope drives it towards the man at covers who does well to stop the ball.

Good effort in the end! Full ball on middle and leg, Ambris lofts this over the man at mid-wicket. The fielder hares after it and just about pulls the ball back in play before crashing into the boundary cushions. The batters take three runs by the time the fielder can come back in and throw the ball back.
Hope pushes this full ball towards the man at mid on and takes a single.

A slower delivery outside the off pole line, it does not bounce much. Hope looks to have a poke at it and guide it down the third man region but the ball sneaks through his bat and pad. Goes to the keeper on a couple of bounces.
This time a touch fuller, pushed towards the man at cover.
Good length ball on off, pushed towards the man at mid off.
Good length delivery on off, Ambris blocks it off the front foot.

DROPPED! Sandakan drops a sitter! On a length on middle by Pradeep, Hope shuffles across and looks to flick it. The ball though does not stay down and it goes uppishly towards short fine leg where Sandakan tries to take the catch but spills it. Hope is a man in form coming off the back of a century in the last match and this can prove to be costly. The batsmen take a single in the meantime.
On a length on middle, Hope flicks it through square leg. The batsmen pick up a couple.
FOUR! Another exquisite shot! Length delivery on middle, Hope flicks it through square leg and bags another boundary. Shai trying to accelerate here which is against his typical batting style.
Full again on middle, Hope drives it towards mid on.
FOUR! Excellent timing! Full delivery on middle, Hope flicks it through mid-wicket and the ball races away to the fence.
Full delivery on middle, Hope drives it through mid on for a run.
On a length on middle, Ambris flicks it through square leg for a single.
Good length delivery on off, Ambris defends it towards mid off.
Full delivery on middle, Hope flicks it through mid-wicket. The fielder from inside the circle chases after it and does well to stop it. The batters get three runs.
On a length on middle, Hope flicks it to mid-wicket.
Good length ball on off, Hope defends it off the back foot towards cover.
On a good length on off, Ambris defends it off the back foot. 9 runs off the over. Best one so far!
BEATEN! Good length delivery outside off, Ambris looks to defend but misses it as he plays inside the line.
FOUR! That is put away! Short of a length delivery, Ambris pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
On a good length on middle, Ambris keeps it out.
On a length on middle, Hope flicks it through square leg for a single.
FOUR! First signs of aggression from Shai Hope! Full delivery on off, Hope slams it over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Full again on off, Hope drives it towards mid off for a run.
FOUR! Graceful! Full delivery on off, Hope delightfully drives it through the cover region. The fielder hares after it and dives to pull it back in play but fails to do so.
Full delivery on middle, Hope looks to drive but gets it off the inner half of the bat. It goes towards mid-wicket.
On a length on off, Hope plays it towards point.
Full and outside off, driven to covers.
Shortish and around off, Hope works it towards square leg.
Another inside edge! A full ball just outside off again, this time Hope tries to drive but gets an inside edge. The ball rolls towards square leg and they cross ends.
Full and just outside off, Ambris once again looks to drive but the ball takes the inside edge and goes to fine leg for a run.
Fuller and around off, Ambris drives it well but finds mid off.

WIDE! But excellent take from the keeper. Pradeep bends his back and bowls a bouncer on middle. However, it goes way over the batter. Perera leaps high in the air and does well to pouch the ball. Wided by the square leg umpire.
Good length ball around off, Ambris looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Shortish and around off, Ambris pushes it back to the bowler.
Shortish and on the body, Hope tucks it towards square leg and takes a run.
Good length ball outside off, Hope punches it wide of the mid off fielder for a single. The fielder there made a tumbling stop to his left. 2 from Perera's first over, another good one for Sri Lanka.
Good length ball around off, Hope pushes it towards point.
Full and around off and middle, flicked to mid-wicket.
Landed around off on a shortish length, Hope blocks it out.
A length ball around off, it comes into the batter with the angle after pitching. Hope looks to defend but the ball takes the inside edge and hits his pad. Lucky that it didn't go onto the stumps.
Ambris is off the mark off the first ball too. A full ball from Perera, Ambris drives it wide of the mid off fielder for a run.
Thisara Perera to bowl from the other end with the second new ball.
Shortish and on middle, Hope is solid in his defense off his back foot. Decent first over from Pradeep.
Leading edge! This wasn't too far away. A fuller ball on middle, Hope tries to flick it towards the leg side but the ball takes the leading edge and goes uppishly towards covers.

A couple now! Pradeep goes fuller but the line is outside off, Hope leans into the shot and drives it through covers. The ball hits the upper part of the willow and once again fails to reach the fence.
Shortish and just around off, Hope rides the bounce and taps it towards point.
Another good length ball around off and middle, this time Hope comes forward and keeps it out.

Runs straightaway! A good length ball on middle, Hope flicks it towards deep mid-wicket. He does not go hard at the ball and just times it. So, it does not go to the fence and the mid-wicket fielder chases it down. A couple to get off the mark.

We are back for the chase. The Sri Lankan players are out in the middle. Shai Hope and Sunil Ambris will open their batting for West Indies. Nuwan Pradeep will start the proceedings for Sri Lanka with the first new ball. Two slips in place. Here we go...
